title: If M lies near x in the line x + ℝv up to an H¹-null set, every 1-dimensional approximate tangent space of M at x is ℝv (parent step 4)
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (M N : Set (Euclid P)) (x v : Euclid P) (δ : ℝ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), v ≠ 0 → 0 < δ → (μHE[1] : Measure (Euclid P)) N = 0 → M ∩ ball x δ ⊆ range (fun s : ℝ => x + s • v) ∪ N → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt 1 M x Q → Q = Submodule.span ℝ {v}
